name: MANAC Chemical Partners Co.,Ltd
summary: MANAC Chemical Partners Co., Ltd and its subsidiaries develop, manufacture, sell, import and export industrial chemicals and pharmaceutical products, mainly in Japan. They supply technology industries with raw materials, among them food additives, veterinary medicines, flame retardants, photosensitive substances and antimicrobial agents, and also rent warehouse space. Dating from 1948, the company has its head office in Tokyo, Japan.
